content: Pool Leshap Mǝ Shang Káa Fin Ntoom Agripa
Mishkoom Agripa sat mPool nǝnee, <<Mo shínpee ngha, mbǝkǝ nghan leshap ɗi shikáa fwaa.>> Aasǝ ɓǝ Pool ɗiyeep sar fin, ɓǝ wur leshap mǝ shang káa fin. Wur sat nǝnee,
<<Azeen-zeen, mishkoom Agripa, yaksǝ ɓǝ nǝ fes shang nghan zam, mbǝɗe wen nkatpee leshap mǝ shang nkáa fen ntoom fwaa cicinsǝ, nkaa mbii ɗe nnen Yahudi moo sat cin nkaa an mo jir.
Mbǝɗǝ gha kǝ man ɗes zam, nkaa mǝse mǝ mbii ɗe mo a mǝ nnen Yahudi mo, kǝ pwoo nkaa mbii ɗe moo ɓǝlep nkaa nǝ zak. Wen nɗang pǝ gha, a gung kǝn nghan kǝlǝng mbii ɗe an mbǝ nsat mo shi pǝtuup mǝ gung.
Nnen Yahudi mo jir, mo man tong fen, peegyet nkutɗi a nzǝlang. Mɓut nnen fen mo, kǝ nɗǝǝn Jerusalem zak, jì wul cicinsǝ.
Mo man an peegyet ɗi nshee. Kǝzak katɗang ɓǝ ɗe moo reɓet langtǝng nǝ, yoo mon nsat nǝ, azeen an a ngu Farisi, ɗe nǝ a mee soon ɗe mo fes ɗar ɓal-ɓal nkaa seyil nNaan fun nǝ.
Mbǝmǝnǝ kǝn ɗar mpee ɗesǝ, mbǝkǝ mmo tokɗyeel ɗi nghan, a mbǝɗe an pǝ canciin nkaa gampwoo ɗe gyet Naan kǝ cweer nǝn mpuun fun mo.

A pwoo ɗe gyet Naan kǝ cweer nsoon fun ɗe kaapaat baavǝl sǝ mo, ɗe moo canciin mbǝ lap nǝ, ɗang mo kǝ gung mbǝ seyil nNaan mpar kǝ puus, mbǝ canciin ɗesǝ. Ɓǝ nnen Yahudi mo dǝm kǝ ɗyeel fen, ntoom fwaa mishkoom!
A mii le ɗang baa nnen Yahudi mon mmak shinzeen nǝ, Naan mbǝ nyool kǝ nnen ɗe mo kǝ murep a peemúut kas yii?
Gyet wen mpan shikáa fen nǝ, an mbǝ cìn mbii ɗe mmak jir, mbǝkǝ nghan tekook kǝ sǝm Jesu ngu Nazaret ɗi.
Gyet a mbii ɗe ncìn nJerusalem mmǝnǝ, ɗe kǝn nlap ɓal pǝ pris ɗenan mo. Gyet kǝn shoot nenseet nɗang Jesu mo ɗes nɗǝǝn lushoot, kǝzak gyet an mɓwoon nnen ɗe mo twe nenseet nɗang Jesu nǝ mo zak.

Yit ɗes, ɓǝ nshinjeel nnenseet nɗang Jesu nǝ mo nɗǝǝn lu Naan mo zak. Gyet kǝn reɓet le kǝn mmo cíipwoo nǝ, baa Jesu a Kristi kas. Mbǝɗǝ gyet njar naa mo nyit bǝbish zam. Mbǝ mǝnǝ ɓǝ gyet mmwaan ndǝm mpee nkaam ɗe baa mo a mǝ nnen Yahudi mo kas, mbǝkǝ nghan nshinjeel ɗi nnenseet nɗang Jesu mo.>>
Pool Leshap Nkaa Tuwap fin
<<Par sǝ mpuus ɓǝ an a ar dǝm nDamaskus mbǝ yak nenseet nɗang Jesu nǝ mo, shi ɓal ɗe kǝn nlap pǝ pris ɗenan mo, ɗǝ a mo lep an zak.
Ɓǝ kaaɗe puus a naar, mishkoom! Yaksǝ nnaa mee peeɓang ɗe nǝ tong aɗeng sham ɓangpee, ɗe nǝ met mɓangpee mǝ puus. Nǝ ɓangpee neer an cǝǝrkaat ashak kǝ nen ɗe mo ashak kǝ an.
Ɓǝ mun jir mu ɗong nyil, ɓǝ nkǝlǝng mee ɗoo nǝ sat nghan shi liispwoo Hiburu nǝnee, <Sool, Sool, a mii le ɗang waa aa shinjeel nghan yii? Nǝn nshwal ngha, kǝn nghan cut sak shi deelkam ɗe peet peet.>
Ɓǝ ntal nǝnee, <A gha wii Daa?> Yaksǝ Daa sat nghan nǝnee, <A an Jesu ɗe aa shinjeel nghan sǝ.
Yaksǝ a yool a ɗar atǝng, mbǝɗe an mbǝ woo sen fen ngha, a mbǝkǝ nghan ɗee ɗe a nguɗak fen, kǝ nguɗar langtǝng ngurum mo nkaa mbii ɗe aa naa, kǝ mbii ɗe an mbǝ kám mo nghan zak.>
An mbǝ ɓam gha nsar nnen Isreil mo, kǝ nsar nnen ɗe baa mo a nnen Yahudi mo kas. An mbǝ lep gha shindǝm pǝ nnen ɗe baa mo a nnen Yahudi mo kas zak.

Mbǝkǝ nghan wang yit mo mo ɗi. Kǝn mmo yit peenkwoo, kǝ mmo ɗel ɗi nɗǝǝn peeɓang. Kǝzak mbǝkǝ mmo put ɗi mɓut mɓal mǝ ngujwaan. Kǝn mmo jì ɗi pǝ Naan zak. Mbǝkǝ katɗang mo shinzeen, ɓǝ mon nkat fwoo mǝ shikbish fur mo, kǝn mon nkat peetong ɗe ashak kǝ nen ɗe Naan kǝ ten bǝlǝp mo zak.>>
Pool Leshap Nkaa Ɗak Fin
<<Mishkoom Agripa, baa gyet ncii cìn mbii ɗe suun ɗe nǝ tong aɗeng sham sat nghan kas.

Gyet nshee satpwoo Naan nǝ a nnen Damaskus mo, ɗang ndǝm kǝn nghan sat ɗe nnen Jerusalem mo, kǝ yil ɗe mo neer Judiya jir. Aɓwoon mǝnǝ, ɓǝ nsat nnen ɗe baa mo a nnen Yahudi mo kas zak. An pǝ sat mmo tuwap, kǝn mmo ciir pǝ Naan ɗi, kǝn mmo cìn ɗak ɗe nǝ kám tuwap mo nǝ ɗi zak.
A mpeemǝnǝ, ɗang nnen Yahudi mo yaa an nɗǝǝn Lu Naan ɗeɗes, kǝ gyet mo kǝ tang ar mbǝ tu an.

Ɗangɓǝ mbǝɗe nkat ɓam pǝ Naan ɗi, a nǝ le ɗang kǝn nɗar ɗi ntoom fwaa mbǝ cicinsǝ. An nkaa satpwoo Naan nǝ nennan mo, kǝ jep ɗeɗyeen mo jir. Baa nsat a mmee pwoo ɗecì kas, tǝng a pwoo ɗe nensatpwoo Naan mo, kǝ Mosis mo kǝ ten sat nǝ, nǝn nyool cìn a kǝsǝ.
Nǝ, tǝng Kristi mbǝ shwaajeel, kǝ a wur a ngwe ɗenshee mǝ yool a peemúut zak. A wur mbǝ shee leshap nkaa peeɓang nǝ nnen Yahudi mo, kǝ nen ɗe baa mo a nnen Yahudi mo kas zak.>>
Pool Reɓet Kǝn Agripa Shinzeen
Kaaɗe Pool nkaa leshap mbǝ shang káa nǝ, ɓǝ Festus sat shii ɗoo ɗeɗes nǝnee, <<Pool aa tǝttar aa? Man fwaa nii le gha ɗee a ngutar.>>
Ɓǝ Pool lap nǝnee, <<Baa an a ngutar kas Festus, ngwe ɗeret met jir. An kǝn sat a pwoo ɗe mo azeen-zeen kǝ ɗe mo a ndǝre zak.
Mishkoom man mbii ɗe kǝn nsat sǝ mo agaak. Mbǝɗǝ mman azeen-zeen nǝ, baa mee mbii loom gha mɓut mbii ɗesǝ mo jir kas. Mbǝɗǝ baa gyet mo cìn mbii mǝnǝ mo a sǝsok kas.
Mishkoom Agripa, a shinzeen nnensat pwoo mǝ Naan mo ee? Mman nǝ, a shinzeen.>>
Mishkoom Agripa sat mPool nǝnee, <<Nɗǝǝn reppee ɗi lee sǝ, ɓǝ aa reɓet ciir kǝ an, kǝn nghan nɗee ɗi a nguseet nɗang Jesu ee?>>

Pool lap nǝnee, <<koo a nɗǝǝn reppee lee. Koo a nɗǝǝn pee ɗe nǝ ɗes, ɓǝ an nkaa ɗangnaan mbǝ gha, kǝ nnen ɗe mo nkaa kǝlǝng an cicinsǝ jir, mbǝkǝ mmo tuwap kǝn mmo ɗee ɗi a nenseet nɗang Jesu koo an sǝ. Ɗangɓe taji a shi shoolbǝring kaaɗe an kǝ nǝ sǝ kas.>>
Aɓwoon mǝnǝ, ɓǝ mishkoom yool, kǝ gofna, kǝ Benis, kǝ nnen ɗe mo kǝ tong ashak kǝ mo.
Ɓǝ mo dǝm mmee koop mbǝsut, ɓǝ mo ɓeet kǝ shak nǝnee, <<Baa gwar ɗesǝ kǝ cìn mee mbii ɗebish ɗe nǝ mak muut, koo mo nle wur nɗǝǝn lushoot kas.>>
Agripa sat nFestus nǝnee, <<Katɗang yoo baa gwar ɗesǝ wur kǝ ɗang mbǝ dǝm kǝ ɗyeel nǝ pǝ Siza ɗi kas, ɓǝ yoo mon ɓwet wur.>>
